name_en: Futomaki Zushi — Boso's picture-cut sushi roll
summary_ja: 酢飯に卵焼きや干瓢、青菜、桜でんぶを組み合わせ、巻いて切ると華やかな絵柄が現れる太巻き。房総の農家で祭りや節句のたびにつくられ、断面の図柄を見せ合う楽しみが受け継がれてきたと伝わる。
summary_en: Sushi rice rolled with rolled omelet, kanpyo, greens, and pink oboro fish flakes reveals a bright picture when sliced — a Boso farmhouse dish said to be made for festivals and seasonal turning points, its cut pattern shown off from house to house.
source_title: 太巻ずし 千葉県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
